title: Knappis - Vibe coded with my 3 year old
author: Wesztman

comments.author: Wesztman
comments.body:
Could not find a game which was easy enough for my 3 year old to learn the gamepad so we sat down together with Opus and created one ourselves 😊 [https://wesztman.github.io/knappis/](https://wesztman.github.io/knappis/)

It's very simple so far and only supports an Xbox style controller, because I wanted him to easily connect the image on the screen to the controller we have.

So far you can change the walking speed and change modes from "Free play" - go to a button and press it, and "Find the button" - go to the indicated button and press it. All features requested and tested by the stakeholder himself.

If there are any issues please leave an issue on the github, link in the lower right corner 😊 Reasonable PR:s are welcome!

Cheers

comments.author: max13007
comments.body: Very cute! Cool way to get kids into gaming too. What better way than to show their ideas come to life!
